pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark contiguous regions consist of large, irregular polygonal shapes on the lower neck that transition into smaller, more rounded sub-circular patches on the mid-flank. Edges display smooth pixel gradients with soft transitions into the lighter background pelage, lacking sharp angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, wide-channeled network of negative space. Junction nodes are distinctly visible, primarily as trilateral intersections. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across both the neck and flank regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette with high-frequency jagged peaks against the background.
